referee_caveats_inferred: Spectral-index flattening during flares is judged by visual inspection, with no statistical test
Lag uncertainties of 2-3 days are comparable to the 6-day bin, so the 0.16-0.48 pc offset rests on weak evidence
Pearson coefficients from overlapping bin sizes are not independent, so the quoted scatter does not reflect statistical significance
Correlation among sparsely and unevenly sampled red-noise light curves is sensitive to the PSD model, which has large parameter uncertainties
Calibrator-catalogue flux densities mix measurements at different frequencies and epochs, with no stated error treatment
Distance estimate depends on assumed beta_app and viewing angle
